_doc: [onboard] The first-minutes story objectives (story/objectives.gd, ui/objective_card.gd). One at a time, in order, each with a one-line why (desc). brief.lines: WREN's one last message in the crash (two subtitle lines), then she is silent until the Signal Tower (story/signal_tower.gd). Objective fields: text (title), desc (the why), hint (shown instead of desc until wait_flag is set), type stat|robot|zone|hub_level|flag|core|tower|upgrade|bench ([v1guide] the workbench tier, ui/bench_tiers.gd), key, target (absolute: lifetime stats), desc/hint may hold {action} key glyphs, e.g. {cube} ([v1guide]); hex (true: outline the target hex on the ground with its % cleaned), lines (WREN, when the objective starts). Data stays English; tr() at display.

wren_brief._doc: [v2guide] WREN once the signal tower carries her (story/objectives.gd _narrate): who she is and the plan home. Then each new story step speaks its lines[0], once.
lines: Lumi, it's WREN. I run the Cradle, our big ship. I never stopped listening for you.
The Cradle can't land on a dead world. Let's make Verdance green again.
Every plant fills your Bloom Core. When it's full, the Cradle comes down and we go home.
Lumi, it's WREN, up on the Cradle. Your pod crashed, and my signal is weak.
Pick up trash, find parts, and build a signal tower so we can talk. I'll be [glitch]listen—[/glitch]

objectives.desc: Hold {scoop} to pick up trash. Empty it at the bin.
lines: Start small, Lumi. Every load in the bin earns cubes.

objectives.desc: Workbench: Chest Size. Fewer trips to the bin.
lines: A bigger chest means fewer trips. The bench can fit one.

objectives.desc: Workbench: grab more trash at once.
lines: A wider scoop. More trash per grab, less walking.

objectives.desc: The Baler squeezes trash into bales. Bales sell for more.
lines: Save up for the Baler. Bales sell for much more than loose trash.

objectives.desc: Full chest? Press {cube} for a bale. Carry it to the scale.
lines: Carry bales to the scale by the bin. Three of them and the base wakes up.

objectives.desc: Workbench, Build tab. Then WREN can talk to you.
lines: Build the tower, Lumi. Then I can stay with you.

objectives.desc: Pick up every piece inside the outline.
lines: First, one clean hex. Clear the outlined one. Green starts on clean ground.

objectives.desc: Clean ground lets plants grow again.
lines: Two clean hexes. Keep going, Lumi.

objectives.desc: 3 clean hexes unlock the Bot Bay.
lines: Three clean hexes. The planet notices, believe me.

objectives.text: Add a Bot Bay to the bench
lines: Add a Bot Bay to the bench. You shouldn't do this alone.

objectives.desc: Workbench, Bots tab. Robots clean for you.
lines: The base has power! Enough to build you a helper. Try the Bots tab at the workbench.

objectives.desc: Press {open_command}, then paint hexes for it to clean.
lines: Give your robot a hex to work on. It wants a job.

objectives.desc: It carries bales to the scale for you.
lines: A Haul Bug carries bales for you. Build one at the bench.

objectives.hint: Keep cleaning. Seeds turn up in clean ground.
lines: Something green is waking out there. Plant the first seed.

objectives.desc: Workbench, Upgrades tab. More robots can work.
lines: The base can grow now. Rebuild it from the Upgrades tab at the workbench.
Boost the tower. I want to hear you clearly.

objectives.desc: Workbench, Upgrades tab. It opens the Request Board.
lines: One more base level. The Cradle is watching, Lumi.
